```python
@staticmethod
    def delete_goal(db: Session, current_user: UserModel, fitnessgoal_id: int) -> None:
        goal = FitnessGoalController.get_goal(db, current_user, fitnessgoal_id)

        # Relation constraint: if goal has recorded progress events, cannot delete to retain history
        event_count = db.execute(
            select(ProgressEventModel).where(ProgressEventModel.goal_id == goal.id)
        ).scalars().all()
        if event_count:
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                "Cannot delete goal with recorded progress events; goal history is retained",
                "Conflict",
            )

        goal.is_deleted = True
        try:
            db.commit()
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def list_goals(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        user_id: Optional[int],
        metric: Optional[GoalMetricEnum],
        goal_status: Optional[GoalStatusEnum],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> FitnessGoalListResponse:
        query = select(FitnessGoalModel).where(FitnessGoalModel.is_deleted.is_(False))

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.user_id == current_user.id)
        elif user_id is not None:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.user_id == user_id)

        if metric:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.metric == metric.value)
        if goal_status:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.status == goal_status.value)
        if after_id is not None:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(FitnessGoalModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        results = db.execute(query).scalars().all()

        next_after_id = None
        if len(results) > limit:
            items = results[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = results

        return FitnessGoalListResponse(
            items=[FitnessGoalResponse.model_validate(it) for it in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )
```

```python
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and goal.user_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Access forbidden", "Forbidden")

        return goal
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def get_goal_progress(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        fitnessgoal_id: int,
    ) -> GoalProgressResponse:
        goal = FitnessGoalController.get_goal(db, current_user, fitnessgoal_id)

        events = db.execute(
            select(ProgressEventModel)
            .where(ProgressEventModel.goal_id == goal.id)
            .order_by(ProgressEventModel.event_date.asc())
        ).scalars().all()

        validated_events = [e for e in events if e.is_validated]

        # Calculate progress current value
        current_val = 0.0
        if validated_events:
            if goal.metric == GoalMetricEnum.STRENGTH.value:
                current_val = max(e.value for e in validated_events)
            elif goal.metric in (
                GoalMetricEnum.DISTANCE.value,
                GoalMetricEnum.SESSIONS.value,
            ):
                current_val = sum(e.value for e in validated_events)
            else:  # WEIGHT, BODY_FAT: latest reading
                current_val = validated_events[-1].value

        pct = 0.0
        if goal.target_value > 0:
            pct = min(100.0, round((current_val / goal.target_value) * 100.0, 2))

        latest_dt = validated_events[-1].event_date if validated_events else None

        return GoalProgressResponse(
            goal_id=goal.id,
            title=goal.title,
            metric=GoalMetricEnum(goal.metric),
            target_value=goal.target_value,
            current_value=current_val,
            progress_percentage=pct,
            status=GoalStatusEnum(goal.status),
            exercise=goal.exercise,
            start_date=goal.start_date,
            end_date=goal.end_date,
            total_events=len(events),
            latest_event_date=latest_dt,
            events=[ProgressEventResponse.model_validate(e) for e in events],
        )
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def get_personal_records(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        user_id: Optional[int],
        metric: Optional[GoalMetricEnum],
        exercise: Optional[str],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> PersonalRecordsListResponse:
        query = (
            select(ProgressEventModel, FitnessGoalModel)
            .join(FitnessGoalModel, ProgressEventModel.goal_id == FitnessGoalModel.id)
            .where(
                ProgressEventModel.is_validated.is_(True),
                FitnessGoalModel.is_deleted.is_(False),
            )
        )

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.user_id == current_user.id)
        elif user_id is not None:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.user_id == user_id)

        if metric:
            query = query.where(FitnessGoalModel.metric == metric.value)
        if exercise:
            query = query.where(
                (ProgressEventModel.exercise == exercise)
                | (FitnessGoalModel.exercise == exercise)
            )

        query = query.order_by(ProgressEventModel.id.asc())
        rows = db.execute(query).all()

        # Aggregate records: best value per (user_id, metric, exercise)
        best_records: Dict[tuple, tuple[ProgressEventModel, FitnessGoalModel]] = {}
        for ev, g in rows:
            ex_key = ev.exercise or g.exercise or "general"
            key = (g.user_id, g.metric, ex_key)
            if key not in best_records:
                best_records[key] = (ev, g)
            else:
                curr_ev, curr_g = best_records[key]
                if g.metric in (GoalMetricEnum.WEIGHT.value, GoalMetricEnum.BODY_FAT.value):
                    if ev.value < curr_ev.value:
                        best_records[key] = (ev, g)
                else:
                    if ev.value > curr_ev.value:
                        best_records[key] = (ev, g)

        record_items: List[PersonalRecordItem] = []
        for (uid, m_str, ex_k), (ev, g) in sorted(
            best_records.items(), key=lambda x: x[1][0].id
        ):
            if after_id is not None and ev.id <= after_id:
                continue
            record_items.append(
                PersonalRecordItem(
                    user_id=g.user_id,
                    metric=GoalMetricEnum(g.metric),
                    exercise=ev.exercise or g.exercise,
                    record_value=ev.value,
                    achieved_at=ev.event_date,
                    goal_id=g.id,
                    progress_event_id=ev.id,
                )
            )

        next_after_id = None
        if len(record_items) > limit:
            items = record_items[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].progress_event_id
        else:
            items = record_items

        return PersonalRecordsListResponse(
            items=items,
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )
```

```python
            if dup:

        if payload.exercise is not None:

        if payload.experience_level is not None:
            limit_obj.experience_level = payload.experience_level.value
        if payload.max_kg is not None:
```

```python
    def patch_event(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        progressevent_id: int,
        payload: ProgressEventPatchRequest,
    ) -> ProgressEventModel:
        event = ProgressEventController.get_event(db, current_user, progressevent_id)
        goal = db.execute(
            select(FitnessGoalModel).where(FitnessGoalModel.id == event.goal_id)
        ).scalar_one()

        if goal.status in (GoalStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value, GoalStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value):
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                f"Cannot modify progress events of a {goal.status} goal",
                "Conflict",
            )

        if payload.event_date is not None:
            if not (to_utc(goal.start_date) <= to_utc(payload.event_date) <= to_utc(goal.end_date)):
                raise AppException(
                    status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                    f"event_date {payload.event_date.isoformat()} outside goal interval",
                    "Bad Request",
                )
            event.event_date = payload.event_date

        if payload.exercise is not None:
            event.exercise = payload.exercise

        if payload.notes is not None:
            event.notes = payload.notes

        if payload.value is not None:
            # Check limit if value changed
            exercise_to_check = event.exercise or goal.exercise
            owner_user = db.execute(
                select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == goal.user_id)
            ).scalar_one()

            if (goal.metric == GoalMetricEnum.STRENGTH.value or exercise_to_check) and exercise_to_check:
                limit_obj = db.execute(
                    select(LoadLimitModel).where(
                        LoadLimitModel.exercise == exercise_to_check,
                        LoadLimitModel.experience_level == owner_user.experience_level,
                    )
                ).scalar_one_or_none()

                if limit_obj and payload.value > limit_obj.max_kg:
                    if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
                        raise AppException(
                            status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                            f"Load {payload.value} kg exceeds limit of {limit_obj.max_kg} kg",
                            "Conflict",
                        )
            event.value = payload.value

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(event)
            return event
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

        if not goal:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Goal not found", "Not Found")

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and goal.user_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Access forbidden", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-9-006: Closed goals cannot accept new progress events
        if goal.status in (GoalStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value, GoalStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value):
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                f"Cannot add progress events to a {goal.status} goal",
                "Conflict",
            )

        # REQ-9-003: event_date in goal interval
        if not (to_utc(goal.start_date) <= to_utc(payload.event_date) <= to_utc(goal.end_date)):
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                f"event_date {payload.event_date.isoformat()} outside goal interval "
                f"[{goal.start_date.isoformat()} - {goal.end_date.isoformat()}]",
                "Bad Request",
            )

        exercise_to_check = payload.exercise or goal.exercise
        owner_user = db.execute(
            select(UserModel).where(UserModel.id == goal.user_id)
        ).scalar_one()

        is_validated = True
        validated_by = current_user.id if current_user.role == RoleEnum.ADMIN.value else None
        validated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc) if current_user.role == RoleEnum.ADMIN.value else None

        # REQ-9-005: Strength events exceeding a limit are rejected unless explicitly validated by admin
        if goal.metric == GoalMetricEnum.STRENGTH.value or exercise_to_check:
            if exercise_to_check:
                limit_obj = db.execute(
                    select(LoadLimitModel).where(
                        LoadLimitModel.exercise == exercise_to_check,
                        LoadLimitModel.experience_level == owner_user.experience_level,
                    )
                ).scalar_one_or_none()

                if limit_obj and payload.value > limit_obj.max_kg:
                    if current_user.role == RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
                        is_validated = True
                    else:
                        if payload.allow_pending:
                            is_validated = False
                        else:
                            raise AppException(
                                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                                f"Strength load {payload.value} kg exceeds load limit of {limit_obj.max_kg} kg "
                                f"for {exercise_to_check} ({owner_user.experience_level}). Admin validation required.",
                                "Conflict",
                            )

        event = ProgressEventModel(
            goal_id=goal.id,
            value=payload.value,
            event_date=payload.event_date,
            exercise=exercise_to_check,
            is_validated=is_validated,
            notes=payload.notes,
            validated_by=validated_by,
            validated_at=validated_at,
        )
        db.add(event)

        # Update goal current value if validated
        if is_validated:
            if goal.metric == GoalMetricEnum.STRENGTH.value:
                goal.current_value = max(goal.current_value, payload.value)
            elif goal.metric in (
                GoalMetricEnum.DISTANCE.value,
                GoalMetricEnum.SESSIONS.value,
            ):
                goal.current_value += payload.value
            else:
                goal.current_value = payload.value

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(event)
            return event
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def delete_block(db: Session, current_user: UserModel, planblock_id: int) -> None:
        if planblock_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Resource not found", "Not Found")

        block = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel).where(PlanBlockModel.id == planblock_id)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if not block:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Plan block not found", "Not Found")

        plan = db.execute(
            select(WorkoutPlanModel).where(WorkoutPlanModel.id == block.plan_id)
        ).scalar_one()

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and plan.user_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Access forbidden", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-9-006: Published plans are immutable
        if plan.status == PlanStatusEnum.PUBLISHED.value:
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                "Published plans are immutable; cannot delete blocks of published plan",
                "Conflict",
            )

        # Delete nested sets
        sets = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockSetModel).where(PlanBlockSetModel.block_id == block.id)
        ).scalars().all()
        for s in sets:
            db.delete(s)

        deleted_pos = block.position
        db.delete(block)

        # Shift remaining blocks down to keep positions contiguous
        remaining = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel).where(
                PlanBlockModel.plan_id == plan.id,
                PlanBlockModel.position > deleted_pos,
            )
        ).scalars().all()
        for r in remaining:
            r.position -= 1

        try:
            db.commit()
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
    def list_exercises(

        current_user: UserModel,
        category: Optional[ExerciseCategoryEnum],

        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> ExerciseListResponse:
        query = select(ExerciseModel).where(ExerciseModel.is_deleted.is_(False))

        next_after_id = None
        if len(results) > limit:
            items = results[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = results

        return ExerciseListResponse(
            items=[ExerciseResponse.model_validate(it) for it in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
```

```python
    def patch_block(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        planblock_id: int,
        payload: PlanBlockPatchRequest,
    ) -> PlanBlockResponse:
        if planblock_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Resource not found", "Not Found")

        block = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel).where(PlanBlockModel.id == planblock_id)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if not block:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Plan block not found", "Not Found")

        plan = db.execute(
            select(WorkoutPlanModel).where(WorkoutPlanModel.id == block.plan_id)
        ).scalar_one()

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and plan.user_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Access forbidden", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-9-006: Published plans are immutable
        if plan.status == PlanStatusEnum.PUBLISHED.value:
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                "Published plans are immutable; cannot modify blocks of published plan",
                "Conflict",
            )

        if payload.exercise_id is not None:
            ex = db.execute(
                select(ExerciseModel).where(
                    ExerciseModel.id == payload.exercise_id,
                    ExerciseModel.is_deleted.is_(False),
                )
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if not ex:
                raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Exercise not found", "Not Found")
            if not ex.active:
                raise AppException(status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, "Exercise is not active", "Bad Request")
            block.exercise_id = ex.id

        if payload.notes is not None:
            block.notes = payload.notes

        if payload.position is not None and payload.position != block.position:
            # Check collision
            collision = db.execute(
                select(PlanBlockModel).where(
                    PlanBlockModel.plan_id == plan.id,
                    PlanBlockModel.position == payload.position,
                    PlanBlockModel.id != block.id,
                )
            ).scalar_one_or_none()
            if collision:
                raise AppException(
                    status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    f"Position {payload.position} already occupied in plan; use /move endpoint to reorder",
                    "Conflict",
                )
            block.position = payload.position

        if payload.sets is not None:
            # Delete old sets and add new
            old_sets = db.execute(
                select(PlanBlockSetModel).where(PlanBlockSetModel.block_id == block.id)
            ).scalars().all()
            for os in old_sets:
                db.delete(os)

            for idx, set_item in enumerate(payload.sets, start=1):
                s_obj = PlanBlockSetModel(
                    block_id=block.id,
                    set_number=idx,
                    reps=set_item.reps,
                    rest_seconds=set_item.rest_seconds,
                    target_load_kg=set_item.target_load_kg,
                )
                db.add(s_obj)

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(block)
            sets = db.execute(
                select(PlanBlockSetModel)
                .where(PlanBlockSetModel.block_id == block.id)
                .order_by(PlanBlockSetModel.set_number.asc())
            ).scalars().all()

            return PlanBlockResponse(
                id=block.id,
                plan_id=block.plan_id,
                exercise_id=block.exercise_id,
                position=block.position,
                notes=block.notes,
                sets=[SetResponseSchema.model_validate(s) for s in sets],
                created_at=block.created_at,
                updated_at=block.updated_at,
            )
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def move_block(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        planblock_id: int,
        payload: PlanBlockMoveRequest,
    ) -> PlanBlockResponse:
        if planblock_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Resource not found", "Not Found")

        block = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel).where(PlanBlockModel.id == planblock_id)
        ).scalar_one_or_none()
        if not block:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "Plan block not found", "Not Found")

        plan = db.execute(
            select(WorkoutPlanModel).where(WorkoutPlanModel.id == block.plan_id)
        ).scalar_one()

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and plan.user_id != current_user.id:
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN, "Access forbidden", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-9-006: Published plans are immutable
        if plan.status == PlanStatusEnum.PUBLISHED.value:
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                "Published plans are immutable; cannot move blocks of published plan",
                "Conflict",
            )

        all_blocks = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel)
            .where(PlanBlockModel.plan_id == plan.id)
            .order_by(PlanBlockModel.position.asc())
        ).scalars().all()

        total = len(all_blocks)
        target_pos = payload.new_position
        if not (1 <= target_pos <= total):
            raise AppException(
                status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST,
                f"new_position must be between 1 and {total}",
                "Bad Request",
            )

        current_pos = block.position
        if target_pos != current_pos:
            if target_pos > current_pos:
                # Moving down: shift items between current_pos+1 and target_pos down by 1
                for b in all_blocks:
                    if current_pos < b.position <= target_pos:
                        b.position -= 1
            else:
                # Moving up: shift items between target_pos and current_pos-1 up by 1
                for b in all_blocks:
                    if target_pos <= b.position < current_pos:
                        b.position += 1

            block.position = target_pos

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(block)
            sets = db.execute(
                select(PlanBlockSetModel)
                .where(PlanBlockSetModel.block_id == block.id)
                .order_by(PlanBlockSetModel.set_number.asc())
            ).scalars().all()

            return PlanBlockResponse(
                id=block.id,
                plan_id=block.plan_id,
                exercise_id=block.exercise_id,
                position=block.position,
                notes=block.notes,
                sets=[SetResponseSchema.model_validate(s) for s in sets],
                created_at=block.created_at,
                updated_at=block.updated_at,
            )
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
    def clone_plan(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        workoutplan_id: int,
        payload: WorkoutPlanCloneRequest,
    ) -> WorkoutPlanModel:
        source_plan = WorkoutPlanController.get_plan(db, current_user, workoutplan_id)

        cloned_name = payload.name or f"{source_plan.name} (Copy)"

        # Create cloned plan in DRAFT status
        cloned_plan = WorkoutPlanModel(
            user_id=current_user.id,
            name=cloned_name,
            description=source_plan.description,
            status=PlanStatusEnum.DRAFT.value,
        )
        db.add(cloned_plan)
        db.flush()

        # Copy blocks and sets
        source_blocks = db.execute(
            select(PlanBlockModel)
            .where(PlanBlockModel.plan_id == source_plan.id)
            .order_by(PlanBlockModel.position.asc())
        ).scalars().all()

        for sb in source_blocks:
            cb = PlanBlockModel(
                plan_id=cloned_plan.id,
                exercise_id=sb.exercise_id,
                position=sb.position,
                notes=sb.notes,
            )
            db.add(cb)
            db.flush()

            source_sets = db.execute(
                select(PlanBlockSetModel)
                .where(PlanBlockSetModel.block_id == sb.id)
                .order_by(PlanBlockSetModel.set_number.asc())
            ).scalars().all()

            for ss in source_sets:
                cs = PlanBlockSetModel(
                    block_id=cb.id,
                    set_number=ss.set_number,
                    reps=ss.reps,
                    rest_seconds=ss.rest_seconds,
                    target_load_kg=ss.target_load_kg,
                )
                db.add(cs)

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(cloned_plan)
            return cloned_plan
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(status.HTTP_500_INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, "Database write failure")
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def calculate_one_rm(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        exercise_id: int,
        user_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> OneRepMaxResponse:
        ex = ExerciseController.get_exercise(db, current_user, exercise_id)

        target_uid = current_user.id
        if user_id is not None:
            if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value and user_id != current_user.id:
                raise AppException(
                    status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Users can only check their own 1RM",
                    "Forbidden",
                )
            target_uid = user_id

        # Query all non-void sets for this exercise performed by user
        query = (
            select(PerformedSetModel, WorkoutSessionModel)
            .join(WorkoutSessionModel, PerformedSetModel.session_id == WorkoutSessionModel.id)
            .where(
                PerformedSetModel.exercise_id == ex.id,
                PerformedSetModel.is_void.is_(False),
                WorkoutSessionModel.user_id == target_uid,
                WorkoutSessionModel.is_deleted.is_(False),
                PerformedSetModel.reps >= 1,
                PerformedSetModel.reps <= 20,
            )
        )
        rows = db.execute(query).all()

        max_1rm = None
        best_set = None
        achieved_at = None

        for p_set, sess in rows:
            est_1rm = p_set.calculated_1rm
            if est_1rm is None:
                est_1rm = calculate_epley_1rm(p_set.load_kg, p_set.reps)

            if est_1rm is not None:
                if max_1rm is None or est_1rm > max_1rm:
                    max_1rm = est_1rm
                    best_set = p_set
                    achieved_at = sess.started_at

        return OneRepMaxResponse(
            exercise_id=ex.id,
            exercise_code=ex.code,
            exercise_name=ex.name,
            user_id=target_uid,
            max_1rm=max_1rm,
            based_on_set_id=best_set.id if best_set else None,
            load_kg=best_set.load_kg if best_set else None,
            reps=best_set.reps if best_set else None,
            achieved_at=achieved_at,
        )
```

```python
    def calculate_volume(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        workoutsession_id: int,
    ) -> SessionVolumeResponse:
        session = WorkoutSessionController.get_session(db, current_user, workoutsession_id)

        sets = db.execute(
            select(PerformedSetModel)
            .where(
                PerformedSetModel.session_id == session.id,
                PerformedSetModel.is_void.is_(False),
            )
            .order_by(PerformedSetModel.set_order.asc())
        ).scalars().all()

        total_volume = 0.0
        total_reps = 0
        exercise_map: Dict[int, Dict[str, Any]] = {}

        for s in sets:
            set_vol = round(s.load_kg * s.reps, 2)
            total_volume += set_vol
            total_reps += s.reps

            if s.exercise_id not in exercise_map:
                ex = db.execute(
                    select(ExerciseModel).where(ExerciseModel.id == s.exercise_id)
                ).scalar_one()
                exercise_map[s.exercise_id] = {
                    "exercise_name": ex.name,
                    "volume_kg": 0.0,
                    "sets_count": 0,
                    "reps_count": 0,
                }

            exercise_map[s.exercise_id]["volume_kg"] += set_vol
            exercise_map[s.exercise_id]["sets_count"] += 1
            exercise_map[s.exercise_id]["reps_count"] += s.reps

        breakdown = [
            ExerciseVolumeBreakdown(
                exercise_id=eid,
                exercise_name=data["exercise_name"],
                volume_kg=round(data["volume_kg"], 2),
                sets_count=data["sets_count"],
                reps_count=data["reps_count"],
            )
            for eid, data in exercise_map.items()
        ]

        return SessionVolumeResponse(
            session_id=session.id,
            total_volume_kg=round(total_volume, 2),
            total_sets=len(sets),
            total_reps=total_reps,
            exercise_breakdown=breakdown,
```

```python
            select(PerformedSetModel).where(PerformedSetModel.session_id == session.id)
        ).scalars().all()
        target_order = payload.set_order if payload.set_order is not None else len(existing_count) + 1
```

```python
@classmethod
    def list_maintenances(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        vehicle_id: Optional[int],
        status: Optional[str],
        type_val: Optional[str],
        from_dt: Optional[datetime],
        to_dt: Optional[datetime],
        include_cancelled: bool,
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> MaintenanceListResponse:
        query = select(MaintenanceModel)
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.requester_id == current_user.id)

        if vehicle_id is not None:
            if vehicle_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(404, "vehicle_id must be positive", "Not Found")
            if not db.scalar(select(VehicleModel.id).where(VehicleModel.id == vehicle_id)):
                raise AppException(404, f"Vehicle {vehicle_id} not found", "Not Found")
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == vehicle_id)

        if status is not None:
            try:
                st_enum = MaintenanceStatusEnum(status)
                query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.status == st_enum.value)
            except ValueError:
                raise AppException(400, f"Invalid status: {status}", "Bad Request")
        elif not include_cancelled:
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.status != MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value)

        if type_val is not None:
            try:
                t_enum = MaintenanceTypeEnum(type_val)
                query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.type == t_enum.value)
            except ValueError:
                raise AppException(400, f"Invalid type: {type_val}", "Bad Request")

        if from_dt and to_dt:
            if from_dt > to_dt:
                raise AppException(400, "'from' date cannot be later than 'to' date", "Bad Request")
        if from_dt:
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.planned_start >= from_dt)
        if to_dt:
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.planned_end <= to_dt)

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(422, "after_id must be a positive integer", "Unprocessable Entity")
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(MaintenanceModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        records = list(db.scalars(query).all())
        has_more = len(records) > limit
        items = records[:limit]
        next_id = items[-1].id if (has_more and items) else None

        return MaintenanceListResponse(
            items=[cls.serialize_maintenance(m) for m in items],
            next_after_id=next_id,
        )
```

```python
@classmethod
    def check_maintenance_availability(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        vehicle_id: int,
        planned_start: datetime,
        planned_end: datetime,
        exclude_maintenance_id: Optional[int],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> MaintenanceListResponse:
        VehicleController.get_vehicle_by_id(db, vehicle_id)
        if planned_start.tzinfo is None:
            planned_start = planned_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        if planned_end.tzinfo is None:
            planned_end = planned_end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        if planned_end <= planned_start:
            raise AppException(400, "planned_end must be strictly later than planned_start", "Bad Request")

        query = select(MaintenanceModel).where(
            MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == vehicle_id,
            MaintenanceModel.status.in_([MaintenanceStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value]),
        )
        if exclude_maintenance_id:
            if exclude_maintenance_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "exclude_maintenance_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.id != exclude_maintenance_id)

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(422, "after_id must be positive", "Unprocessable Entity")
            query = query.where(MaintenanceModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(MaintenanceModel.id.asc())
        candidates = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        conflicts = [
            m for m in candidates
            if max(planned_start, m.planned_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if m.planned_start.tzinfo is None else m.planned_start)
            < min(planned_end, m.planned_end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if m.planned_end.tzinfo is None else m.planned_end)
        ]
        has_more = len(conflicts) > limit
        items = conflicts[:limit]
        next_id = items[-1].id if (has_more and items) else None

        return MaintenanceListResponse(
            items=[cls.serialize_maintenance(m) for m in items],
            next_after_id=next_id,
        )
```

```python
        cls,
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        maintenance_id: int,
        payload: MaintenanceCancelRequest,
    ) -> MaintenanceModel:
        m = cls.get_maintenance_by_id(db, current_user, maintenance_id)
        if m.status in (MaintenanceStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value):
            raise AppException(409, f"Cannot cancel terminal maintenance in status {m.status}", "Conflict")

        canc_dt = payload.cancelled_at
        if canc_dt.tzinfo is None:
            canc_dt = canc_dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        plan_start = m.planned_start
        if plan_start.tzinfo is None:
            plan_start = plan_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        if canc_dt < plan_start:
            raise AppException(409, "cancelled_at cannot precede planned_start", "Conflict")

        was_in_progress = m.status == MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value
        if was_in_progress:
            act_start = m.actual_start or m.planned_start
            if act_start.tzinfo is None:
                act_start = act_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            if canc_dt < act_start:
                raise AppException(409, "cancelled_at cannot precede actual_start", "Conflict")
            if not payload.next_vehicle_state:
                raise AppException(422, "next_vehicle_state is required when cancelling IN_PROGRESS maintenance", "Unprocessable Entity")

        previous_st = m.status
        m.status = MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value
        m.cancelled_at = canc_dt.replace(microsecond=0)
        m.cancellation_reason = payload.cancellation_reason

        history = MaintenanceHistoryEventModel(
            maintenance_id=m.id,
            previous_status=previous_st,
            new_status=MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value,
            effective_at=canc_dt.replace(microsecond=0),
            actor_id=current_user.id,
            reason=payload.cancellation_reason,
        )
        db.add(history)

        if was_in_progress and payload.next_vehicle_state:
            other_active = db.scalars(
                select(MaintenanceModel).where(
                    MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == m.vehicle_id,
                    MaintenanceModel.id != m.id,
                    MaintenanceModel.status.in_([MaintenanceStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value]),
                )
            ).first()
            if not other_active:
                vehicle = VehicleController.get_vehicle_by_id(db, m.vehicle_id)
                vehicle.current_state = payload.next_vehicle_state.value

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(m)
        return m
```

```python
    def complete_maintenance(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        maintenance_id: int,
        payload: MaintenanceCompleteRequest,
    ) -> MaintenanceModel:
        m = cls.get_maintenance_by_id(db, current_user, maintenance_id)
        if m.status != MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value:
            raise AppException(409, f"Cannot complete maintenance in status {m.status}", "Conflict")

        end_dt = payload.actual_end
        if end_dt.tzinfo is None:
            end_dt = end_dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        act_start = m.actual_start or m.planned_start
        if act_start.tzinfo is None:
            act_start = act_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        if end_dt < act_start:
            raise AppException(409, "actual_end cannot precede actual_start", "Conflict")

        m.status = MaintenanceStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value
        m.actual_end = end_dt.replace(microsecond=0)
        m.completion_notes = payload.completion_notes

        history = MaintenanceHistoryEventModel(
            maintenance_id=m.id,
            previous_status=MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value,
            new_status=MaintenanceStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value,
            effective_at=end_dt.replace(microsecond=0),
            actor_id=current_user.id,
            reason=payload.completion_notes,
        )
        db.add(history)

        # REQ-1-005: If last active maintenance, atomically update vehicle state
        other_active = db.scalars(
            select(MaintenanceModel).where(
                MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == m.vehicle_id,
                MaintenanceModel.id != m.id,
                MaintenanceModel.status.in_([MaintenanceStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value]),
            )
        ).first()

        if not other_active:
            vehicle = VehicleController.get_vehicle_by_id(db, m.vehicle_id)
            vehicle.current_state = payload.next_vehicle_state.value

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(m)
        return m
```

```python
    def list_drivers(
        db: Session,
        active: Optional[bool],
        employee_code_prefix: Optional[str],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> DriverListResponse:
        query = select(DriverModel)
        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(422, "after_id must be a positive integer", "Unprocessable Entity")
            query = query.where(DriverModel.id > after_id)

        if active is not None:
            query = query.where(DriverModel.active == active)

        if employee_code_prefix is not None:
            norm_prefix = employee_code_prefix.strip().upper()
            if not (1 <= len(norm_prefix) <= 20):
                raise AppException(400, "employee_code_prefix length must be between 1 and 20", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(DriverModel.employee_code.like(f"{norm_prefix}%"))

        query = query.order_by(DriverModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        drivers = list(db.scalars(query).all())
        has_more = len(drivers) > limit
        items = drivers[:limit]
        next_id = items[-1].id if (has_more and items) else None

        return DriverListResponse(
            items=[
                DriverResponse(
                    id=d.id,
                    employee_code=d.employee_code,
                    full_name=d.full_name,
                    active=d.active,
                )
                for d in items
            ],
            next_after_id=next_id,
        )
```

```python
    def patch_trip(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        trip_id: int,
        payload: TripPatchRequest,
    ) -> TripModel:
        trip = cls.get_trip_by_id(db, current_user, trip_id)
        if trip.status != TripStatusEnum.PLANNED.value:
            raise AppException(409, f"Only PLANNED trips can be modified; current status is {trip.status}", "Conflict")

        data = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        if not data:
            raise AppException(400, "Patch payload cannot be empty", "Bad Request")

        new_driver_id = data.get("driver_id", trip.driver_id)
        new_vehicle_id = data.get("vehicle_id", trip.vehicle_id)

        if "driver_id" in data:
            driver = db.scalar(select(DriverModel).where(DriverModel.id == new_driver_id))
            if not driver:
                raise AppException(404, f"Driver {new_driver_id} not found", "Not Found")
            if not driver.active:
                raise AppException(409, f"Driver {new_driver_id} is inactive", "Conflict")

        if "vehicle_id" in data:
            vehicle = db.scalar(select(VehicleModel).where(VehicleModel.id == new_vehicle_id))
            if not vehicle:
                raise AppException(404, f"Vehicle {new_vehicle_id} not found", "Not Found")
            if not vehicle.active:
                raise AppException(409, f"Vehicle {new_vehicle_id} is inactive", "Conflict")
            if vehicle.status == VehicleStatusEnum.OUT_OF_SERVICE.value:
                raise AppException(409, f"Vehicle {new_vehicle_id} is OUT_OF_SERVICE", "Conflict")

        new_start = data.get("planned_start", trip.planned_start)
        if new_start.tzinfo is None:
            new_start = new_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        new_end = data.get("planned_end", trip.planned_end)
        if new_end.tzinfo is None:
            new_end = new_end.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        if new_end <= new_start:
            raise AppException(400, "planned_end must be strictly later than planned_start", "Bad Request")

        ConflictChecker.check_driver_conflict(db, new_driver_id, new_start, new_end, exclude_trip_id=trip.id)
        ConflictChecker.check_vehicle_conflict(db, new_vehicle_id, new_start, new_end, exclude_trip_id=trip.id)

        if "purpose" in data:

        trip.driver_id = new_driver_id
        trip.vehicle_id = new_vehicle_id
        trip.planned_start = new_start.replace(microsecond=0)
        trip.planned_end = new_end.replace(microsecond=0)

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(trip)
```

```python
@classmethod
    def cancel_maintenance(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        maintenance_id: int,
        payload: MaintenanceCancelRequest,
    ) -> MaintenanceModel:
        m = cls.get_maintenance_by_id(db, current_user, maintenance_id)
        if m.status in (MaintenanceStatusEnum.COMPLETED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value):
            raise AppException(409, f"Cannot cancel terminal maintenance in status {m.status}", "Conflict")

        canc_dt = payload.cancelled_at
        if canc_dt.tzinfo is None:
            canc_dt = canc_dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        was_in_progress = m.status == MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value
        if was_in_progress:
            act_start = m.actual_start or m.scheduled_start
            if act_start.tzinfo is None:
                act_start = act_start.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            if canc_dt < act_start:
                raise AppException(409, "cancelled_at cannot precede actual_start", "Conflict")
            if not payload.next_vehicle_state:
                raise AppException(422, "next_vehicle_state is required when cancelling IN_PROGRESS maintenance", "Unprocessable Entity")

        m.status = MaintenanceStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value
        m.cancelled_at = canc_dt.replace(microsecond=0)
        m.cancellation_reason = payload.cancellation_reason

        if was_in_progress and payload.next_vehicle_state:
            other_active = db.scalars(
                select(MaintenanceModel).where(
                    MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == m.vehicle_id,
                    MaintenanceModel.id != m.id,
                    MaintenanceModel.status.in_([MaintenanceStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value]),
                )
            ).first()
            if not other_active:
                event = VehicleStateEventModel(
                    vehicle_id=m.vehicle_id,
                    target_state=payload.next_vehicle_state.value,
                    effective_at=canc_dt.replace(microsecond=0),
                    reason=f"Maintenance {m.id} cancelled: {payload.cancellation_reason[:50]}",
                )
                db.add(event)

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(m)
        return m
```

```python
    def create_state_transition(
        cls,
        db: Session,
        vehicle_id: int,
        payload: StateTransitionRequest,
    ) -> VehicleStateEventModel:
        vehicle = cls.get_vehicle_by_id(db, vehicle_id)
        latest = cls.get_latest_state(vehicle)

        eff_at = payload.effective_at
        if eff_at.tzinfo is None:
            eff_at = eff_at.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        latest_eff = latest.effective_at
        if latest_eff.tzinfo is None:
            latest_eff = latest_eff.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

        if payload.target_state.value == latest.target_state:
            raise AppException(409, f"Target state '{payload.target_state.value}' is identical to current state", "Conflict")

        if eff_at <= latest_eff:
            raise AppException(409, "Effective timestamp must be strictly greater than latest state timestamp", "Conflict")

        if payload.target_state == VehicleStateEnum.MAINTENANCE:
            now_dt = utc_now()
            qualifying_maintenance = db.scalars(
                select(MaintenanceModel).where(
                    MaintenanceModel.vehicle_id == vehicle_id,
                    MaintenanceModel.status.in_([MaintenanceStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value, MaintenanceStatusEnum.IN_PROGRESS.value]),
                    MaintenanceModel.scheduled_start <= eff_at,
                )
            ).first()
            if not qualifying_maintenance:
                raise AppException(
                    409,
                    "Vehicle cannot enter MAINTENANCE without a SCHEDULED or IN_PROGRESS maintenance starting on or before effective_at",
                    "Conflict",
                )

        event = VehicleStateEventModel(
            vehicle_id=vehicle.id,
            target_state=payload.target_state.value,
            effective_at=eff_at.replace(microsecond=0),
            reason=payload.reason,
        )
        db.add(event)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(event)
        return event
```

```python
        if not (MIN_YEAR <= year <= MAX_YEAR):

                AssignmentModel.is_deleted == False,
                AssignmentModel.effective_from <= year_end,
                AssignmentModel.effective_to >= year_start,

        remaining = max(0.0, entitlement - total_used)
```

```python
    def patch_assignment(
        cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, assignment_id: int, payload: AssignmentPatchRequest
    ) -> AssignmentModel:
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Only administrators can update assignments", "Forbidden")

        asg = cls.get_assignment(db, current_user, assignment_id)

        target_emp = payload.employee_id if payload.employee_id is not None else asg.employee_id
        target_dep = payload.department_id if payload.department_id is not None else asg.department_id
        target_role = payload.role_id if payload.role_id is not None else asg.role_id
        target_from = parse_date(payload.effective_from) if payload.effective_from is not None else asg.effective_from
        target_to = parse_date(payload.effective_to) if payload.effective_to is not None else asg.effective_to

        if target_from > target_to:
            raise AppException(422, "effective_from must be less than or equal to effective_to", "Unprocessable Entity")

        if payload.employee_id is not None and payload.employee_id != asg.employee_id:
            emp = db.scalar(select(EmployeeModel).where(EmployeeModel.id == payload.employee_id, EmployeeModel.is_deleted == False))
            if not emp:
                raise AppException(404, f"Employee {payload.employee_id} not found", "Not Found")

        if payload.department_id is not None and payload.department_id != asg.department_id:
            dep = db.scalar(select(DepartmentModel).where(DepartmentModel.id == payload.department_id, DepartmentModel.is_deleted == False))
            if not dep:
                raise AppException(404, f"Department {payload.department_id} not found", "Not Found")

        if payload.role_id is not None and payload.role_id != asg.role_id:
            r = db.scalar(select(RoleModel).where(RoleModel.id == payload.role_id, RoleModel.is_deleted == False))
            if not r:
                raise AppException(404, f"Role {payload.role_id} not found", "Not Found")

        cls.check_assignment_overlap(db, target_emp, target_from, target_to, exclude_id=asg.id)

        asg.employee_id = target_emp
        asg.department_id = target_dep
        asg.role_id = target_role
        asg.effective_from = target_from
        asg.effective_to = target_to
        asg.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(asg)
        return asg
```

```python
            conflict = db.scalar(

                    LeaveBalanceModel.employee_id == target_emp_id,
                    LeaveBalanceModel.leave_type == target_type,
                    LeaveBalanceModel.year == target_year,
                )
            )
            if conflict:
                raise AppException(409, "Conflicting balance exists for target employee, type and year", "Conflict")

            bal.leave_type = target_type
            bal.year = target_year

        if payload.opening_days is not None:
            if payload.opening_days < bal.used_days:
                raise AppException(409, f"Opening days cannot be less than already used days ({bal.used_days})", "Conflict")
            diff = payload.opening_days - bal.opening_days
```

```python
@classmethod
    def cancel_request(
        cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, leave_request_id: int, payload: LeaveCancelRequest
    ) -> LeaveRequestModel:
        req = cls.get_request(db, current_user, leave_request_id)
        canc_dt = parse_utc_timestamp(payload.cancelled_at)

        # Idempotency check
        if req.status == LeaveStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value:
            return req

        if req.status == LeaveStatusEnum.REJECTED.value:
            raise AppException(409, "Rejected requests cannot be cancelled", "Conflict")

        # If it was APPROVED, restore the balance atomically
        if req.status == LeaveStatusEnum.APPROVED.value:
            req_year = req.start_date.year
            bal = db.scalar(
                select(LeaveBalanceModel).where(
                    LeaveBalanceModel.employee_id == req.employee_id,
                    LeaveBalanceModel.leave_type == req.leave_type,
                    LeaveBalanceModel.year == req_year,
                )
            )
            if bal:
                bal.used_days = max(0.0, bal.used_days - req.requested_days)
                bal.remaining_days = bal.opening_days - bal.used_days
                hist = LeaveBalanceHistoryModel(
                    leave_balance_id=bal.id,
                    change_type=BalanceChangeTypeEnum.RESTORATION.value,
                    amount=req.requested_days,
                    resulting_remaining_days=bal.remaining_days,
                    note=f"Restored {req.requested_days:.1f} days due to cancellation of request {req.id}",
                )
                db.add(hist)

        req.status = LeaveStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value
        req.cancelled_at = canc_dt
        req.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(req)
        return req
```

```python
        items = records[:limit]
        next_id = items[-1].id if (has_more and items) else None

        return ProductListResponse(
```

```python
@classmethod
    def patch_transfer(cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, transfer_id: int, payload: TransferPatchRequest) -> TransferModel:
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Admins manage transfers", "Forbidden")

        src_id = payload.source_warehouse_id or transfer.source_warehouse_id

        if src_id == dst_id:

        if payload.source_warehouse_id is not None:
            src = WarehouseController.get_by_id(db, payload.source_warehouse_id)
            if not src.active:
                raise AppException(409, "Source warehouse must be active", "Conflict")
            transfer.source_warehouse_id = src.id

        if payload.dest_warehouse_id is not None:
            dst = WarehouseController.get_by_id(db, payload.dest_warehouse_id)
            if not dst.active:
                raise AppException(409, "Destination warehouse must be active", "Conflict")
            transfer.dest_warehouse_id = dst.id

            prod = ProductController.get_by_id(db, payload.product_id)
            if not prod.active:

            transfer.product_id = prod.id

        if payload.quantity is not None:
            transfer.quantity = payload.quantity

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(transfer)
            return transfer
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(500, "Database error updating transfer", "Internal Server Error")

@classmethod
```
```python
    def cancel_transfer(cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, transfer_id: int) -> TransferModel:
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Admins cancel transfers", "Forbidden")

        transfer = cls.get_by_id(db, transfer_id)

        # Idempotence: if already CANCELLED, return 200
        if transfer.status == TransferStatusEnum.CANCELLED.value:
            return transfer

        if transfer.status not in (TransferStatusEnum.DRAFT.value, TransferStatusEnum.DISPATCHED.value):
            raise AppException(409, f"Cannot cancel transfer in status {transfer.status}", "Conflict")

        # If dispatched, restore stock at source from in-transit
        if transfer.status == TransferStatusEnum.DISPATCHED.value:
            src_stock = db.scalar(
                select(StockLevelModel).where(
                    StockLevelModel.warehouse_id == transfer.source_warehouse_id,
                    StockLevelModel.product_id == transfer.product_id,
                )
            )
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def get_stock_summary(db: Session, product_id: int) -> ProductStockSummarySchema:
        prod = db.query(ProductModel).filter(ProductModel.id == product_id).first()
        if not prod:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Product {product_id} not found",
            )

        stocks = db.query(StockLevelModel).filter(StockLevelModel.product_id == product_id).all()
        rules = {
            r.location_code: r
            for r in db.query(ReorderRuleModel).filter(ReorderRuleModel.product_id == product_id).all()
        }

        total_stock = sum(s.quantity for s in stocks)
        locations_detail: List[LocationStockDetailSchema] = []

        seen_locations = set()
        for s in stocks:
            seen_locations.add(s.location_code)
            rule = rules.get(s.location_code)
            r_point = rule.reorder_point if rule else None
            t_level = rule.target_level if rule else None
            below = (s.quantity <= r_point) if r_point is not None else False
            locations_detail.append(
                LocationStockDetailSchema(
                    location_code=s.location_code,
                    quantity=s.quantity,
                    reorder_point=r_point,
                    target_level=t_level,
                    is_below_reorder_point=below,
                )
            )

        # Include locations that have reorder rules even if stock record is not created
        for loc, rule in rules.items():
            if loc not in seen_locations:
                locations_detail.append(
                    LocationStockDetailSchema(
                        location_code=loc,
                        quantity=0,
                        reorder_point=rule.reorder_point,
                        target_level=rule.target_level,
                        is_below_reorder_point=True,
                    )
                )

        return ProductStockSummarySchema(
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def list_reorder_candidates(
        db: Session,
        location_code: Optional[str] = None,
        limit: int = 20,
        after_id: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> ReorderCandidateListResponseSchema:
        # Candidate rule search
        query = db.query(ReorderRuleModel, ProductModel).join(
            ProductModel, ReorderRuleModel.product_id == ProductModel.id
        ).filter(
            ReorderRuleModel.is_active == True,
            ProductModel.is_active == True,
        )

        if location_code is not None:
            query = query.filter(ReorderRuleModel.location_code == location_code)
        if after_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(ReorderRuleModel.id > after_id)

        rows = query.order_by(ReorderRuleModel.id.asc()).all()

        candidates: List[ReorderCandidateItemSchema] = []
        for rule, prod in rows:
            stock = db.query(StockLevelModel).filter(
                StockLevelModel.product_id == prod.id,
                StockLevelModel.location_code == rule.location_code,
            ).first()
            current_qty = stock.quantity if stock else 0

            if current_qty <= rule.reorder_point:
                suggested = rule.target_level - current_qty
                candidates.append(
                    ReorderCandidateItemSchema(
                        rule_id=rule.id,
                        product_id=prod.id,
                        sku=prod.sku,
                        product_name=prod.name,
                        location_code=rule.location_code,
                        current_stock=current_qty,
                        reorder_point=rule.reorder_point,
                        target_level=rule.target_level,
                        suggested_order_quantity=suggested,
                        is_acknowledged=rule.is_acknowledged,
                    )
                )

        has_more = len(candidates) > limit
        items = candidates[:limit]
        next_after_id = items[-1].rule_id if has_more and items else None

        return ReorderCandidateListResponseSchema(
            items=items,
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )
```

```python
    def patch_category(db: Session, category_id: int, payload: CategoryPatchSchema) -> CategoryModel:

        if not cat:

                CategoryModel.id != category_id,

            if existing:

                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail=f"Category with name '{payload.name}' already exists",
                )
            cat.name = payload.name

        if payload.parent_id is not None:
            if payload.parent_id == category_id:
                raise StarletteHTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail="A category cannot be its own parent",
                )
            parent = db.query(CategoryModel).filter(CategoryModel.id == payload.parent_id).first()
            if not parent:
                raise StarletteHTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                    detail=f"Parent category {payload.parent_id} not found",
                )
            if InventoryVariantCController._check_category_cycle(db, category_id, payload.parent_id):
                raise StarletteHTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail="Parent category assignment creates a circular dependency",
                )
            cat.parent_id = payload.parent_id

        cat.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(cat)
```

```python
            quantity=abs(diff),
            reference=f"Stock reconciliation from {current_qty} to {payload.actual_quantity}",
            is_reversed=False,
        )
        db.add(movement)

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(stock)
            return stock
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(500, "Database error reconciling stock", "Internal Server Error")
```

```python
    def create_movement(cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, payload: StockMovementCreateRequest) -> StockMovementModel:
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Admins create movements", "Forbidden")

        product = ProductController.get_by_id(db, payload.product_id)
        if not product.active:
            raise AppException(409, "Cannot create movement for inactive product", "Conflict")

        stock = db.scalar(
            select(StockLevelModel).where(
                StockLevelModel.product_id == payload.product_id,
                StockLevelModel.location == payload.location,
            )
        )
        if not stock:
            stock = StockLevelModel(
                product_id=payload.product_id,
                location=payload.location,
                quantity=0.0,
            )
            db.add(stock)
            db.flush()

        # REQ-8-005: ISSUE and negative adjustment cannot make stock negative
        if payload.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.INTAKE:
            stock.quantity += payload.quantity
        elif payload.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.ISSUE:
            if stock.quantity < payload.quantity:
                raise AppException(409, "Insufficient stock for issue operation", "Conflict")
            stock.quantity -= payload.quantity
        elif payload.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.ADJUSTMENT:
            # Default adjustment is positive intake unless indicated
            stock.quantity += payload.quantity
```

```python
@classmethod
    def reverse_movement(cls, db: Session, current_user: UserModel, stockmovement_id: int) -> StockMovementModel:
        if current_user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Admins reverse movements", "Forbidden")

        orig = cls.get_by_id(db, stockmovement_id)

        # REQ-8-006: Reversal is immutable history and exactly offsets one unreversed movement
        if orig.is_reversed:
            # Idempotence check: check if already reversed by a reversal record
            reversal_rec = db.scalar(select(StockMovementModel).where(StockMovementModel.reversed_movement_id == orig.id))
            if reversal_rec:
                return reversal_rec
            raise AppException(409, "Movement is already reversed", "Conflict")

        if orig.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.REVERSAL.value:
            raise AppException(409, "Cannot reverse a reversal movement", "Conflict")

        stock = db.scalar(
            select(StockLevelModel).where(
                StockLevelModel.product_id == orig.product_id,
                StockLevelModel.location == orig.location,
            )
        )
        if not stock:
            raise AppException(404, "Associated stock level not found", "Not Found")

        # Offsetting logic
        if orig.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.INTAKE.value:
            if stock.quantity < orig.quantity:
                raise AppException(409, "Reversing intake would cause negative stock", "Conflict")
            stock.quantity -= orig.quantity
        elif orig.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.ISSUE.value:
            stock.quantity += orig.quantity
        elif orig.movement_type == MovementTypeEnum.ADJUSTMENT.value:
            if stock.quantity < orig.quantity:
                raise AppException(409, "Reversing adjustment would cause negative stock", "Conflict")
            stock.quantity -= orig.quantity

        orig.is_reversed = True

        reversal = StockMovementModel(
            product_id=orig.product_id,
            location=orig.location,
            movement_type=MovementTypeEnum.REVERSAL.value,
            quantity=orig.quantity,
            reference=f"Reversal of movement #{orig.id}",
            is_reversed=False,
            reversed_movement_id=orig.id,
        )
        db.add(reversal)

        try:
            db.commit()
            db.refresh(reversal)
            return reversal
        except Exception:
            db.rollback()
            raise AppException(500, "Database error reversing movement", "Internal Server Error")
```

```python
        if after_id is not None and after_id > 0:

        query = query.order_by(ProjectModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        records = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None

            next_after_id = records[limit - 1].id

                key=p.key,
                name=p.name,
                creator_account_id=p.creator_account_id,
                active=p.active,
            )
            for p in records
        ]
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def patch_column(
        db: Session, current_user: UserModel, column_id: int, payload: ColumnPatchPayload
    ) -> ColumnModel:
        col = ColumnController.get_column(db, current_user, column_id)

        if payload.name is not None and payload.name.strip() != col.name:
            trimmed = payload.name.strip()
            dup = db.scalar(
                select(ColumnModel).where(
                    ColumnModel.project_id == col.project_id,
                    ColumnModel.name == trimmed,
                    ColumnModel.id != column_id,
                    ColumnModel.active == True,
                    ColumnModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if dup:
                raise AppException(409, f"Column name '{trimmed}' already exists", "Conflict")
            col.name = trimmed

        if payload.wip_limit is not None and payload.wip_limit != col.wip_limit:
            if payload.wip_limit > 0:
                ticket_count = len(col.tickets)
                if ticket_count > payload.wip_limit:
                    raise AppException(
                        409,
                        f"Cannot set wip_limit to {payload.wip_limit}: column contains {ticket_count} tickets",
                        "Conflict",
                    )
            col.wip_limit = payload.wip_limit

        if payload.active is not None:
            col.active = payload.active

        if payload.position is not None and payload.position != col.position:
            # Reorder positions
            cols = list(
                db.scalars(
                    select(ColumnModel)
                    .where(
                        ColumnModel.project_id == col.project_id,
                        ColumnModel.is_deleted == False,
                        ColumnModel.id != column_id,
                    )
                    .order_by(ColumnModel.position.asc())
                ).all()
            )
            max_pos = len(cols) + 1
            if payload.position < 1 or payload.position > max_pos:
                raise AppException(
                    409,
                    f"Invalid position {payload.position}: must be between 1 and {max_pos}",
                    "Conflict",
                )
            cols.insert(payload.position - 1, col)
            for idx, c in enumerate(cols, start=1):
                c.position = idx

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(col)
        return col
```

```python
            if has_cols or has_tickets:
                raise AppException(
                    409, "Cannot deactivate project with active columns or tickets", "Conflict"
                )
            project.active = False
        elif payload.active is True:
            project.active = True

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(project)
        return project
```

```python
    def create_column(
        db: Session, current_user: UserModel, project_id: int, payload: ColumnCreatePayload
    ) -> ColumnModel:
        project = ProjectController.get_project(db, current_user, project_id)
        if not project.active:
            raise AppException(409, f"Project {project_id} is inactive", "Conflict")

        trimmed_name = payload.name.strip()

        # REQ-5-003: Active column positions and names are unique within a project
        dup_name = db.scalar(
            select(ColumnModel).where(
                ColumnModel.project_id == project_id,
                ColumnModel.name == trimmed_name,
                ColumnModel.active == True,
                ColumnModel.is_deleted == False,
            )
        )
        if dup_name:
            raise AppException(409, f"Column name '{trimmed_name}' already exists in project", "Conflict")

        # Get existing active columns ordered by position
        existing_cols = list(
            db.scalars(
                select(ColumnModel)
                .where(
                    ColumnModel.project_id == project_id,
                    ColumnModel.active == True,
                    ColumnModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
                .order_by(ColumnModel.position.asc())
            ).all()
        )

        max_pos = len(existing_cols) + 1
        if payload.position < 1 or payload.position > max_pos:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Invalid insertion position {payload.position}: must be between 1 and {max_pos}",
                "Conflict",
            )

        # Shift existing columns at or after payload.position
        for c in existing_cols:
            if c.position >= payload.position:
                c.position += 1

        col = ColumnModel(
            project_id=project_id,
            name=trimmed_name,
            position=payload.position,
            wip_limit=payload.wip_limit,
            active=True,
            is_deleted=False,
        )
        db.add(col)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(col)
        return col
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def bulk_move_tickets(
        db: Session, current_user: UserModel, project_id: int, payload: BulkMovePayload
    ) -> List[TicketModel]:
        ProjectController.get_project(db, current_user, project_id)
        target_col = ColumnController.get_column(db, current_user, payload.target_column_id)

        if target_col.project_id != project_id:
            raise AppException(409, "Target column belongs to a different project", "Conflict")

        tickets_map = {}
        for tid in payload.ticket_ids:
            t = db.scalar(select(TicketModel).where(TicketModel.id == tid))
            if not t:
                raise AppException(404, f"Ticket {tid} not found", "Not Found")
            if t.project_id != project_id:
                raise AppException(409, f"Ticket {tid} does not belong to project {project_id}", "Conflict")
            tickets_map[tid] = t

        ordered_requested_tickets = [tickets_map[tid] for tid in payload.ticket_ids]

        # Calculate new items joining target column from external columns
        incoming_count = sum(1 for t in ordered_requested_tickets if t.column_id != target_col.id)
        current_target_count = len(target_col.tickets)

        if target_col.wip_limit > 0 and (current_target_count + incoming_count) > target_col.wip_limit:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Bulk move would exceed target column WIP limit ({current_target_count + incoming_count} > {target_col.wip_limit})",
                "Conflict",
            )

        requested_ids_set = set(payload.ticket_ids)
        existing_target_remaining = list(
            db.scalars(
                select(TicketModel)
                .where(
                    TicketModel.column_id == target_col.id,
                    ~TicketModel.id.in_(requested_ids_set),
                )
                .order_by(TicketModel.position.asc())
            ).all()
        )

        source_col_ids = {t.column_id for t in ordered_requested_tickets if t.column_id != target_col.id}

        for t in ordered_requested_tickets:
            t.column_id = target_col.id

        if payload.placement == PlacementEnum.TOP:
            final_target_order = ordered_requested_tickets + existing_target_remaining
        else:
            final_target_order = existing_target_remaining + ordered_requested_tickets

        for idx, t in enumerate(final_target_order, start=1):
            t.position = idx

        # Renumber affected source columns
        for sc_id in source_col_ids:
            sc_tickets = list(
                db.scalars(
                    select(TicketModel)
                    .where(
                        TicketModel.column_id == sc_id,
                        ~TicketModel.id.in_(requested_ids_set),
                    )
                    .order_by(TicketModel.position.asc())
                ).all()
            )
            for idx, t in enumerate(sc_tickets, start=1):
                t.position = idx

        db.commit()
        return ordered_requested_tickets
```

```python
@staticmethod
    def move_ticket(
        db: Session, current_user: UserModel, ticket_id: int, payload: TicketMovePayload
    ) -> TicketModel:
        ticket = TicketController.get_ticket(db, current_user, ticket_id)
        target_col = ColumnController.get_column(db, current_user, payload.target_column_id)

        if target_col.project_id != ticket.project_id:
            raise AppException(409, "Target column belongs to a different project", "Conflict")

        # If moving to another column, check target WIP limit
        if target_col.id != ticket.column_id:
            if target_col.wip_limit > 0 and len(target_col.tickets) >= target_col.wip_limit:
                raise AppException(
                    409, f"Target column has reached its WIP limit of {target_col.wip_limit}", "Conflict"
                )

        # Target tickets excluding moving ticket
        target_tickets = list(
            db.scalars(
                select(TicketModel)
                .where(
                    TicketModel.column_id == target_col.id,
                    TicketModel.id != ticket_id,
                )
                .order_by(TicketModel.position.asc())
            ).all()
        )

        insert_index = 0
        if payload.after_ticket_id is not None:
            found_idx = None
            for idx, t in enumerate(target_tickets):
                if t.id == payload.after_ticket_id:
                    found_idx = idx
                    break
            if found_idx is None:
                raise AppException(
                    409,
                    f"after_ticket_id {payload.after_ticket_id} not found in target column",
                    "Conflict",
                )
            insert_index = found_idx + 1

        old_column_id = ticket.column_id
        ticket.column_id = target_col.id

        target_tickets.insert(insert_index, ticket)
        for idx, t in enumerate(target_tickets, start=1):
            t.position = idx

        # If moved between columns, renumber old column
        if old_column_id != target_col.id:
            old_col_tickets = list(
                db.scalars(
                    select(TicketModel)
                    .where(
                        TicketModel.column_id == old_column_id,
                        TicketModel.id != ticket_id,
                    )
                    .order_by(TicketModel.position.asc())
                ).all()
            )
            for idx, t in enumerate(old_col_tickets, start=1):
                t.position = idx

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(ticket)
        return ticket
```

```python
                    MembershipModel.project_id == project_id,

                    MembershipModel.active == True,
                )

            if not mem or mem.role != MembershipRoleEnum.MANAGER.value:
                raise AppException(403, "Manager privileges required to delete project", "Forbidden")

        # REQ-5-008: A project can be soft-deleted only when it has no tickets and no active non-creator memberships
        has_tickets = db.scalar(select(TicketModel).where(TicketModel.project_id == project_id).limit(1))
        if has_tickets:
            raise AppException(409, "Cannot delete project with existing tickets", "Conflict")

        has_other_active_members = db.scalar(
            select(MembershipModel)
            .where(
                MembershipModel.project_id == project_id,
                MembershipModel.account_id != project.creator_account_id,
                MembershipModel.active == True,
            )
            .limit(1)
        )
        if has_other_active_members:
            raise AppException(
                409, "Cannot delete project with active non-creator memberships", "Conflict"
            )

        project.is_deleted = True
        append_audit_event(
            db,
            current_user.id,
            project.id,
            AuditEventTypeEnum.PROJECT_DELETED,
            "PROJECT",
```
